name: Kilimanjaro National Park
intro: Kilimanjaro National Park, located in northern Tanzania, is home to Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa’s highest peak at 5,895 meters. The park protects an extraordinary range of landscapes, from lush tropical rainforests and alpine meadows to the iconic snow-capped summit. This dramatic change in ecosystems makes Kilimanjaro one of the most unique natural areas in Africa and a top destination for trekking, adventure travel, and nature lovers.

Beyond its legendary summit, the park also offers rich biodiversity in its lower forest zones, where visitors can encounter elephants, buffalo, monkeys, and a wide variety of bird species. As a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Kilimanjaro National Park is not only a symbol of natural beauty and adventure but also a must-visit destination for travelers seeking an unforgettable African experience.
